title: 米兰到戛纳故事板表
author: Lilidi · AI
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,草图 / 线稿,插画,角色,城市景观 / 街景
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a hand-drawn cinematic storyboard sheet about a woman traveling from Milan to Cannes with a hard drive, drawn like a rough pencil-and-colored-pencil production board.

Canvas: Landscape 16:9 off-white paper background, slightly textured, scanned sketchbook look. Use thin red-orange borders for all storyboard frames and the bottom icon strip. The drawing style is loose graphite pencil with soft pale blue, gray, tan, and muted red washes; imperfect perspective, visible sketch lines, handwritten lettering, and intentionally misspelled storyboard notes.

Header: Across the top in large uneven black hand-lettering, write “FROM MILANO TO CANNES - STORYBOBARD”. In the top-right corner add a small rounded rectangle label with the handwritten text “2 BOSIS → TO AVE”.

Layout: Use exactly 6 main storyboard panels arranged in 2 rows of 3 panels. Each panel has a thin red-orange rectangular border and a short handwritten caption beneath it. Number the panels visibly as 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, and 7, preserving the skipped numbering. Use a recurring young woman protagonist, an unnamed woman, with shoulder-length dark hair and a simple sleeveless or short-sleeved top; her face may be softly blurred or minimally detailed.

Panel details and captions:
1. Interior desk scene: the woman sits side-on at a table with an open laptop, a small bowl or cup, and a soft city view through tall windows. Caption: “FINAL CUT S AM, AND FEMJUER- OUR PBSY FILR IN A TOLAND AFSAGMENT”.
2. Close-up of a hand resting on a bag or jacket, beside a small labeled hard drive or tag. Caption: “ONE HARD DRIVE, ONE LANVARD UNE SHOT.”
3. Coastal road arrival scene with palm trees, a blue road or sea, and distant Cannes-like buildings. Caption: “THE GOAST UNROALS ITALY BECOMES FRANCE,”.
4. Street on the Croisette: the woman seen from behind near palm trees, a car, a pale building façade, and a small roadside sign. Caption: “CANNE’S THE CROISEITE, HEART FOUNDING.”
6. The woman viewed from behind looking up at a cinema or festival building sign with scribbled lettering. Caption: “THERE. HFE MANE. THE BOROO.^ THREE TIMES. TO BELIEVE IT.”
7. Red carpet hallway or grand interior: the woman stands in profile looking upward, surrounded by sketchy crowds on both sides and a red carpet leading forward. Caption: “TWENTY FOUR STEPS EVERY FLASH A TEAR OF WORK.”

Bottom strip: Add one long horizontal red-orange bordered strip divided into exactly 10 small rectangular cells, each containing a tiny rough icon and a handwritten label beneath. From left to right: 1) small capsule/drive icon labeled “CAPYERA PRAME MOTION.”, 2) curved arrow and letters labeled “SI REEKE.”, 3) fast arrow mark with no separate large caption beyond the strip alignment, 4) diamond/eye shape labeled “DIRECTON.”, 5) small lips/oval icon with no extra caption, 6) tilted square labeled “FORCE”, 7) star labeled “CURRENT”, 8) outlined star labeled “MAGIC:”, 9) rounded rectangle labeled “APPEARANCE”, 10) small flag/lightning mark labeled “MAGIC”.

Visual constraints: Keep all text hand-drawn, uneven, and slightly nonsensical as if drafted quickly in a storyboard notebook. Maintain muted handmade texture, no photorealism, no clean digital UI, no watermark, and do not add extra storyboard panels beyond the 6 main panels and 10 bottom icon cells.\

title: 与梦中生物一起沉睡的孩子

prompt_en: Create a dreamy cinematic square image of a sleeping child in a soft pastel bedroom at night, surrounded by cute tiny fantasy dream creatures. The child, young child, lies sideways under a pale floral blanket on a fluffy pillow, with dark hair visible and face mostly turned toward the pillow, peaceful and asleep. Use a warm muted film look with shallow depth of field, soft grain, gentle vignetting, and cozy low light from a small lantern. Include exactly 8 visible creatures: 1 large plush-like white spiky creature peeking over the left pillow with glossy black eyes; 1 small beige bug-like creature with two antennae sitting on the left pillow; 1 fuzzy mint-green humanoid creature standing near the child and holding a tiny glowing lantern; 1 small golden floating creature with tiny horns hovering in the blurred background above the child; 1 brown fuzzy rabbit-like creature with translucent insect wings sitting on the right pillow; 1 pale blue rounded ghost-like creature smiling from the right background; 1 tiny pale pink bunny creature seen from behind at the bottom center foreground; and 1 blue-green spiky creature sitting at the lower right, turned toward the sleeping child. Bedroom details should be softly blurred: patterned wallpaper, framed pictures, shelves, and warm nursery decor. Color palette: dusty pink, cream, mint green, pale blue, warm amber. Mood: good dreams, tender, whimsical, quiet. Style: photorealistic miniature fantasy creatures mixed with soft Studio Ghibli-like dream realism. Camera: close intimate bedside view, 1:1 square composition, eye-level, 35mm lens feel, shallow focus on the sleeping child and nearby creatures. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no horror tone, no sharp harsh lighting, keep all creatures gentle and toy-like with rounded bodies and glossy eyes.\

She has long damp dark brown hair with straight bangs, wears oversized black headphones topped with sleek black cat-ear attachments, and her face is intentionally soft and obscured by shadow/blur for an anonymous editorial look. Her outfit is a dusty blue cropped hoodie with distressed cold-shoulder cutouts and matching short shorts, black ankle socks, and chunky lavender, white, and black futuristic sneakers; one sneaker is exaggerated in the foreground with strong wide-angle perspective. She hugs the umbrella handle while crouching with knees forward, and one small gray tabby kitten sits tucked inside the partially zipped hoodie at her chest, looking directly at the viewer. The scene contains exactly one umbrella, one kitten, one pair of cat-ear headphones, one pair of chunky sneakers, and five visible floating transparent bubbles around the subject. Add scattered pale pink cherry blossom petals on the wet ground, puddle reflections, falling rain streaks, misty gray urban buildings blurred in the background, cool blue-gray color grading, shallow depth of field, glossy wet textures, emotional melancholic atmosphere, soft diffused overcast lighting, ultra-detailed raindrops on the umbrella, realistic fabric texture, and a dreamy high-fashion street photography composition shot from a low angle with a vertical 9:16 frame.\

Place a large electronic scoreboard in the upper right with inning numbers, scores, and dense Japanese-style team/player text, glowing realistically but not needing to be fully legible. Mood: dramatic, tense, heartwarming live-game atmosphere, like a decisive late-inning pitch. Use natural stadium lighting, deep night sky, photorealistic detail, slight motion energy, crisp foreground, and a wide 16:9 composition. Customize the batter as a powerful right-handed hitter in gray with black sleeves, the stadium as a large Japanese baseball stadium, the scoreboard score as 1 to 5, and the camera style as professional sports photojournalism with cinematic realism. title: 动漫博尔德救援喜剧场景
author: Cartoonverse AI
categories: 社交媒体帖子,漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,角色,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dynamic full-body anime/manga illustration of a comedic fantasy-drama scene featuring Hana struggling under an absurdly huge boulder while others refuse or fail to help.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 composition on a clean white background, low-angle perspective that makes the characters look tall and heroic, with the top of the giant boulder cropped by the upper edge of the image.

Subjects and count: Show exactly 5 living subjects: 4 human characters and 1 cat. Human 1 is the central athletic young woman with short messy black hair, wearing a cropped black top, blue bomber jacket, dark high-waisted shorts with chain accessories, thigh strap, black socks, and oversized blue-and-black sneakers; she stands with legs apart and both arms fully raised, palms pressed against a massive cracked stone boulder above her head. Human 2 is a tall blond young man standing to her right, arms crossed, relaxed and unimpressed, wearing a sage-green jacket over a mustard yellow shirt, brown cargo pants with a chain, and rugged green-brown sneakers. Human 3 is a small purple-haired girl at the far lower left, wearing a blue denim outfit and pointing toward the central woman while laughing or accusing. Human 4 is a dark-haired young man at the far lower right, wearing a blue jacket and dark pants, also pointing toward the central woman. Subject 5 is a Siamese-like cat centered near the bottom between the two main adults, cream fur with dark ears, muzzle, paws, and curled tail, bright blue eyes, mouth open in a dramatic meow.

Composition: The central woman and the blond man dominate the frame from shoes to shoulders; their faces are covered by soft rectangular blur blocks as if intentionally censored. The two smaller side characters also have blurred face rectangles. The boulder is enormous, dark gray-brown, rough, cracked, and heavy-looking, with small falling pebbles around it. The central woman is visibly straining, while the blond man remains smugly idle.

Text content: Add exactly 2 speech/handwritten text elements. On the left near the straining woman, handwritten text says: “Help Zack, we’re gonna die!!” with a small pointer line aimed toward her. On the upper right near the blond man, a white speech bubble says: “I’m not helping her”.

Visual style: High-detail contemporary anime illustration with clean ink lines, painterly shading, fashionable streetwear, expressive body language, exaggerated low-angle anatomy, crisp white negative space, subtle ground shadows, and a humorous dramatic tone. Use blue for the central woman’s jacket and enormous for the stone overhead.

Constraints: Keep exactly 4 humans, exactly 1 cat, exactly 2 text elements, and exactly 1 giant boulder. Do not add a background environment, extra props, extra speech bubbles, logos, or watermarks.\

The first is a “PROFILE” box with the account name “@multusdim_AI” and several lines of Japanese profile text describing an AI visual creator focused on atmosphere-rich work blending photorealism, retro future, maid aesthetics, and steampunk.
